setup.title: Enable hub
setup.intro: This machine is standalone — it is not part of a mesh yet. Pick one of the two paths below.
setup.introDetail: Making this machine the hub creates the first user here and lets other machines join it; it needs an address that is reachable over HTTPS. Joining an existing hub turns this machine into a node of a mesh someone else already runs. Either way the gateway writes its configuration and restarts once.

becomeHub.title: Make this machine the hub
becomeHub.description: Creates the first user here and accepts join requests from other machines. Needs a public HTTPS address.

joinHub.title: Join an existing hub
joinHub.description: Turns this machine into a node. You need a join string issued by the hub; it is valid for 10 minutes.

becomeHub.title: Make this machine the hub
becomeHub.description: Creates the first user, issues this machine's own node certificate, then restarts the gateway with the role hub,node.

joinHub.title: Join an existing hub
joinHub.description: Same as running `tmex-cli hub join` on this machine. After the join succeeds the gateway restarts as a node.

fields.hubPublicUrlHint: The HTTPS address browsers and `hub join` will use, for example https://tmex.example.com. Every machine that joins must be able to reach it.
fields.usernameHint: 1-64 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen.
fields.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Your root key is derived from this password, so it cannot be recovered from the server.
fields.hubUrlHint: The hub's HTTPS address, for example https://tmex.example.com. HTTP redirects are rejected.
fields.tokenHint: Issued by `tmex-cli enroll` on the hub, or from the Nodes page of any signed-in entry. Valid for 10 minutes. Whitespace and line breaks are stripped.
fields.name: Node name
fields.nameHint: Shown in the sidebar and on the Nodes page.
fields.directEnableHint: Downloads the native add-on for this platform so nodes can talk to each other directly instead of relaying through the hub. A failure here does not block setup.
fields.directUnsupportedHint: No native add-on is published for {{platform}}; traffic will relay through the hub.
fields.insecureLocal: Allow an http:// hub on this machine
fields.insecureLocalHint: Development and test only: permits http://127.0.0.1 or http://localhost as the hub address. Not available in production.

precheck.reachableSelf: Reachable, and it answers as this machine. The address is ready to use as the hub's public address.
precheck.reachableOther: Reachable (HTTP {{status}}), but it answers as a different tmex instance. Check the address before continuing.
precheck.httpsHint: tmex does not terminate HTTPS itself yet, so the public address has to be served by a reverse proxy or a Cloudflare Tunnel in front of this machine. Built-in HTTPS comes in a later release.
precheck.docsHint: See docs/hub/2026082800-hub-node-operations.md, sections 「Cloudflare Tunnel 与反代」 and 「首次搭 hub」.

setup.title: 启用 hub
setup.intro: 本机当前是 standalone（尚未加入任何 mesh）。请从下面两条路径中选一。
setup.introDetail: 把本机变成 hub：在本机创建首个用户，其他机器再加入进来，需要一个外部可达的 HTTPS 地址。加入已有 hub：本机变成别人已经建好的 mesh 里的一个节点。两条路径都会写配置并重启一次网关。

becomeHub.title: 把本机变成 hub
becomeHub.description: 在本机创建首个用户，并受理其他机器的加入请求。需要对外的 HTTPS 地址。

joinHub.title: 加入已有 hub
joinHub.description: 把本机变成一个节点。需要 hub 签发的 join 串，默认 10 分钟内有效。

becomeHub.title: 把本机变成 hub
becomeHub.description: 创建首个用户、签发本机的节点证书，然后以 hub,node 角色重启网关。

joinHub.title: 加入已有 hub
joinHub.description: 等价于在本机执行 `tmex-cli hub join`。加入成功后网关以 node 角色重启。

fields.hubPublicUrlHint: 浏览器与 `hub join` 使用的 HTTPS 地址，如 https://tmex.example.com。所有要加入的机器都必须能访问它。
fields.usernameHint: 1-64 个字符，只能用字母、数字、点、下划线、连字符。
fields.passwordHint: 至少 8 位。根钥由该密码推导，服务端无法找回。
fields.hubUrlHint: hub 的 HTTPS 地址，如 https://tmex.example.com。HTTP 重定向一律拒绝。
fields.tokenHint: 由 hub 上的 `tmex-cli enroll` 或任意已登录入口的 Nodes 页签发，默认 10 分钟内有效。粘贴时的空白与换行会自动去掉。
fields.tokenPlaceholder: 粘贴 128 位的 join 串
fields.name: 节点名称
fields.nameHint: 会显示在侧边栏与 Nodes 页。
fields.directEnableHint: 下载当前平台的原生插件，让节点之间直接通信而不走 hub 中转。失败不阻断安装。
fields.directUnsupportedHint: {{platform}} 没有发布原生插件，流量将经由 hub 中转。
fields.insecureLocalHint: 仅开发与测试环境：允许把 http://127.0.0.1 或 http://localhost 当作 hub 地址。production 下不可用。

precheck.reachableSelf: 可达，且响应的就是本机。该地址可以直接用作 hub 对外地址。

precheck.httpsHint: tmex 目前不自己终结 HTTPS，对外地址需要由本机前面的反代或 Cloudflare Tunnel 提供。内置 HTTPS 会在后续版本提供。
precheck.docsHint: 参见 docs/hub/2026082800-hub-node-operations.md 的「Cloudflare Tunnel 与反代」与「首次搭 hub」两节。

setup.title: hub を有効化
setup.intro: このマシンは standalone で、まだ mesh に参加していません。下の 2 つのうち 1 つを選んでください。
setup.introDetail: このマシンを hub にする場合は、ここで最初のユーザーを作成し、他のマシンが参加できるようになります。HTTPS で到達できるアドレスが必要です。既存の hub に参加する場合は、このマシンがその mesh のノードになります。いずれも設定を書き込んでゲートウェイを 1 回再起動します。

becomeHub.title: このマシンを hub にする

joinHub.description: このマシンで `tmex-cli hub join` を実行するのと同じです。成功するとノードとして再起動します。
